info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Webhook Subscription Status API
info.description: The Update Webhook Subscription Status API allows clients to modify the status of a specific webhook subscription identified by its unique webhookId. This endpoint is essential for managing the operational state of webhook subscriptions, ensuring that notifications are sent or paused as per business requirements. Typical users include developers and system administrators who need to dynamically adjust webhook behavior in response to system events or status changes. The API streamlines the process of maintaining and configuring webhook interactions with external systems.

put.summary: Update the status of a specified webhook.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the status of a specific webhook identified by its unique resource identifier. Use this operation to change the current state of the webhook to reflect new status updates as necessary.
